title: Order page
question: how a cancelled order reads at a glance, and where the refund stands

directions.changes: a full-width status banner above the order with the refund line inside it
directions.wins: the person came to check one thing: is it cancelled, where is my money
directions.costs: the banner pushes the items below the fold on a phone

directions.changes: the status is a vertical timeline beside the items: placed, paid, cancelled, refund pending
directions.wins: support and repeat customers who want the history
directions.costs: more to read for a one-off buyer; a fourth column on desktop

directions.changes: a status pill in the header and one refund sentence under the total; the page otherwise unchanged
directions.wins: the order page stays the order page; cancellation is rare
directions.costs: easy to miss that the refund is still pending

recommendation.reason: a person opens a cancelled order to find out about the refund; nothing else on the page matters at that moment
